proven_facts: The inherited full-metadata discovery route emits result source and candidate discovery_source APT_FULL_METADATA_XAPIAN.
Those candidates carry binding_kind=apt and, when Contents proves an executable owner, eligibility_status=LOCAL_EXECUTABLE_OWNERSHIP_VERIFIED plus evidence_tier=SEMANTIC_PACKAGE_EXECUTABLE_OWNERSHIP.
auto_capability_acquisition._discovery_supplier_order reads binding_kind before discovery_source, so these candidates correctly route to the apt_cli supplier class.

auto_apt_cli_acquisition._viable_candidates unconditionally continues unless discovery_source equals APT_CATALOG, so every APT_FULL_METADATA_XAPIAN candidate is discarded before apt probing or contract inference.

The same function requires numeric score >=12, a threshold defined for the legacy handcrafted APT_CATALOG lexical score; APT_FULL_METADATA_XAPIAN score is a Xapian BM25 weight and is not the same calibrated scale.
minimum_sufficient_repair: Admit APT_FULL_METADATA_XAPIAN candidates only when zero-cost/zero-secret/zero-friction identity requirements hold and executable ownership is verified by the semantic executable evidence tier.
Do not apply the legacy APT_CATALOG numeric relevance threshold to Xapian BM25 weights.
Preserve candidate provenance and Xapian ordering; do not add package hints or task-specific literals.
Ensure federated discovery treats APT_FULL_METADATA_XAPIAN as a local APT source rather than a remote/unknown source.
